quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: Mizuho Securities selects HPE to accelerate advanced (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer: Mizuho Securities selected HPE Cray XD2000 featuring direct liquid cooling and will build a new direct-liquid-cooling-ready data center for it, to run financial simulations (derivatives pricing, market risk and counterparty credit risk) involving more than 360 million calculations per day. Installation of the liquid cooling equipment, system buildout and operational validation begin this fall, with the system scheduled to go into production in mid-2027. The initial deployment comprises eight server nodes, with Mizuho Securities planning to expand servers and racks in stages; it plans to validate direct liquid cooling through this system as it explores GPU-accelerated compute for its future private AI infrastructure. Per HPE, direct liquid cooling in this configuration delivers up to 20% performance improvement per kilowatt over air-cooled solutions and consumes 15% less power, and Mizuho Securities expects 1.6 times the performance per server node versus its current environment. HPE Services will provide monitoring and maintenance including real-time visibility into the direct liquid cooling and power infrastructure and automated coolant leak alerts. Hirokazu Mochizuki, SVP and managing director for HPE Japan, calls Mizuho Securities the first in Japan's financial sector to select HPE Cray XD2000 featuring direct liquid cooling. No contract value is stated.
